chapterInfo.content:
4
Yona abufuo ne n’atenetene
1Na asɛm yi anyɛ Yona dɛ koraa, na ne bo fui. 2#Eks 34.6 Na ɔbisaa AWURADE sɛ: Ao, AWURADE! ɛnyɛ m’asɛm a meda so mewɔ m’asase soɔ no mekaeɛ nie? Yei ara nti na meyɛɛ ntɛm sɛ meredwane akɔ Tarsis, ɛfiri sɛ menim sɛ wo deɛ, woyɛ Onyankopɔn ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ, wo bo kyɛre fu na w’adɔeɛ dɔɔso, na wosesa w’adwene wɔ mmusuo a wode reba ho. 3#1 Ah 19.4 Na afei, AWURADE, gye me kra firi me nsam ɛ, na ɛyɛ ma me sɛ mɛwu sene sɛ mɛtena ase. 4#Yona 4.9 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛyɛ sɛ wo bo fu anaa? 5Na Yona firii adi firii kuro no mu, na ɔkɔtenaa kuro no apueeɛ, na ɔbɔɔ sese hɔ, na ɔtenaa aseɛ enwunu no mu sɛ ɛnkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhunu adekodeɛ a ɛbɛyɛ kuro no.
6Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn siesiee adedenkruma, na ɛfefɛ kataa Yona so maa n’atifi nyaa enwunu, sɛ ɛnyi no mfiri n’ahohiahia no mu. Na Yona ani gyee adedenkruma no ho kɛseɛ. 7Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a owia reba abɛpue no, Onyankopɔn siesiee aboaa bi maa no fitii adedenkruma no mu maa no poe. 8Na ɛbaa sɛ owia pueeɛ no, Onyankopɔn siesiee apueeɛ mframa a emu yɛ hyeɛ, na owia bɔɔ Yona atifi maa no tɔɔ piti. Na ɔsrɛɛ sɛ anka ɔnwu, na ɔse: Owuo yɛ ma me sene nkwa.
9 # Yona 4.4 Ɛnna Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Yona sɛ: Ɛyɛ sɛ wo bo fuu adedenkruma no ho anaa? Na Yona buaa sɛ: Aane ɛyɛ sɛ me bo fu de kɔ owuo mu. 10Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Wo deɛ, adedenkruma no asɛm no yɛ wo ya, nso wonyɛɛ ɛho adwuma biara, na ɛnyɛ wo na womaa no nyiniiɛ, na ɛbaa anadwo koro na ɛsɛee anadwo koro. 11#Yona 3.3 Na me deɛ, Ninewe kuro kɛseɛ a nnipa bɛboro ɔpeha aduonu a wɔnnim nifa ne benkum ne afieboa pii nso wɔ mu no deɛ renyɛ me ya anaa?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
